title: InferRequest — planner→pod inference task (CP-mediated; the pod polls, nothing dials in)
description: One BATCHED call per kind, never per-segment. align: the pod runs a pure wav2vec2 forward over the given windows and PUTs the emission log-softmax matrices (npz, layout in README) — post-processing stays on the planner, no text crosses. face_probe: the pod runs YuNet over sampled frames of the given shots and PUTs raw boxes (+frame_diff) as JSON (face_probe.schema.json) — decisions stay on the planner. clip_rank: the pod runs both SigLIP towers over many (intent, images) groups and PUTs cosines + L2-normalized image embeddings as JSON (clip_rank.schema.json) — the reorder, the relevance floor and the MMR dedup stay on the planner, so no threshold appears here by construction.

weights.description: Where the pod gets this job's checkpoint — NOTHING heavy is baked into the image. A presigned GET for a tar of the model directory, plus that tar's sha256, which is BOTH the integrity check and the pod's cache key (so a revised checkpoint can never be served from a stale cache entry). REQUIRED for align and clip_rank; forbidden on face_probe, whose 227 KB YuNet stays in the image.

size.description: Expected tar size in bytes; a mismatch fails the fetch.

keep_ids.description: OPTIONAL column projection for the returned emissions: the sorted, de-duplicated set of vocab indices the caller's CTC forced alignment will read (its target ids plus blank). Present → the pod PUTs emissions_<i> with exactly these columns, in this order, and echoes keep_ids in the npz meta; absent → the full vocab width, byte-identical to before. It is an ALPHABET, not text: no word, no order and no count crosses with it, and nothing here decides anything — the alignment itself stays on the planner.

clip_rank.description: MANY groups per call: a montage scores many candidates across many beats, and one round trip per beat would dominate the wall clock. A request is EITHER a rank (>=1 group, no judge_tiles) OR a judge-tiles request (groups == [] and >=1 judge tile); groups stays required.

judge_tiles.description: Judge tiles to make: per pair the pod fetches the stock-provider ORIGIN url and PUTs one small JPEG of it to the presigned put_url (the judge keeps PER-TILE images — one object per tile, never a sheet). Only with groups == [].

intent.description: The English meaning to score against. "" = embed-only: the image tower is text-independent, so the group still yields embeddings and its scores come back as -1.0.

image_urls.description: Presigned GETs, fetched under the presigned-only rule. A group carries exactly one of image_urls or origin_urls.

origin_urls.description: Stock-provider ORIGIN thumbnail URLs the pod fetches itself (MISC-333). A group carries exactly one of image_urls or origin_urls; image_cells are not allowed with origin_urls.

image_cells.description: Optional crop per image_urls item: [x,y,width,height,sheet_width,sheet_height]. Only with image_urls.

span.description: [start, end] seconds, source time, end > start (model-enforced).
